_note: Record = 24 bytes: u32 Konami card id, then 5 u32 code pointers (0 = slot unused). Records are sorted by id. Slot meanings are not named in the exe; slot 1 is always set (main effect routine), the others are optional per card (activation condition / target choice / cost / continuous effect - inferred from which cards fill them). Found by scanning data sections for runs of such records.
